question: Which of the following is the most appropriate definition of classification?
options: The study of naming living organisms based on Latin terms
The arrangement of living organisms into groups based on their similarities and differences
The identification of organisms using molecular and genetic tools only
The study of evolutionary relationships among organisms

question: Which of the following is NOT true about taxonomy?
options: It involves identification, naming, and classification of organisms
It deals only with naming of organisms without grouping them
It helps in understanding relationships among organisms
It involves grouping organisms based on similarities and differences

question: Classification of living organisms by scientists can be grouped into how many eras?
Which era is regarded as the earliest in the history of taxonomy?
In the Pre-Linnaean era, organisms were grouped based on which of the following?
Who is considered the father of biological classification?
Which of the following scientists based his classification on the growth form of living organisms?
Which of the following scientists wrote the book De Materia Medica?
Dioscorides classified organisms based on which of the following?
All of the following are early taxonomists EXCEPT
Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with its classification system?
options: Theophrastus — Classification based on growth form of organisms
John Ray — Classification based only on evolutionary DNA evidence
Caesalpino — Classification based on growth habit of plants and seeds
Dioscorides — Classification based on medicinal properties of plants

question: Which of the following scientists constructed botanical classification emphasizing the system later accepted by Linnaeus?
Which of the following best describes the Linnaean era in taxonomy?
options: It marked the beginning of modern classification and introduced binomial nomenclature
It focused mainly on evolutionary DNA analysis of organisms
It classified organisms solely based on medicinal properties
It was based on numerical scoring of characters

question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the Linnaean era?
options: Classification of organisms into two kingdoms (Plantae and Animalia)
Use of molecular genetics in classification

options: Classifying organisms based on evolutionary relationships rather than morphology

question: Charles Darwin was best known in taxonomy for
options: Classifying organisms based on habitat only

options: It is based on evolutionary relationships among organisms
